_comment: Checked top to bottom; up to two matching templates are combined. A template with 'alert': true (customer issue) is sent alone and also goes to Discord so a person follows up in DMs. 'excludes' drops more generic templates when this one matches. Triggers are regular expressions, case-insensitive.
